# Manah Group of Companies

> Manah Group is a diversified enterprise group founded in 2018 and headquartered in Hyderabad, India, delivering engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and engineering excellence across six divisions: Manah Dynamics, Manah Green Energy, Manah Atomic, Manah Aerospace, Manah AI, and Manah Investments.

Manah Group operates across power transmission and distribution, renewable energy, green hydrogen, nuclear energy (Small Modular Reactors), aviation MRO, generative AI and data centers, and strategic investments. The group is active in 15+ Indian states with a project pipeline exceeding ₹20,000 Cr.

## Divisions

- [Manah Dynamics](https://www.manah.com/divisions/dynamics): Projects, infrastructure and electronics manufacturing — the flagship EPC division.
- [Manah Green Energy](https://www.manah.com/divisions/green-energy): Green hydrogen production and renewable energy infrastructure.
- [Manah Atomic](https://www.manah.com/divisions/atomic): Nuclear energy solutions — Small Modular Reactors and advanced reactors.
- [Manah Aerospace](https://www.manah.com/divisions/aerospace): Aviation MRO, training and consultancy (DGCA-certified).
- [Manah AI](https://www.manah.com/divisions/ai): Generative AI, agentic systems, LLM/SLM training, and data centers.
- [Manah Investments](https://www.manah.com/divisions/investments): Strategic capital deployment across infrastructure, energy and deep tech.

## Sectors

End-market industries served, one detail page each:

- [Power T&D](https://www.manah.com/sectors/power-transmission): EHV/HV transmission lines up to 765 kV, substations and grid infrastructure.
- [Renewables](https://www.manah.com/sectors/renewable-energy): Utility-scale solar, wind, hydel and hybrid renewable EPC.
- [Building & Roads](https://www.manah.com/sectors/building-roads): Highways, bridges, residential and industrial civil infrastructure.
- [Telecom](https://www.manah.com/sectors/telecom): Telecom towers, BharatNet fiber and active network rollout.
- [Defence](https://www.manah.com/sectors/defence): Firearms, communication devices and RF-based defence systems.
- [Oil & Gas](https://www.manah.com/sectors/oil-gas): Refinery allied works, pipelines and LNG terminal balance-of-plant.
- [Mining](https://www.manah.com/sectors/mining): Mine infrastructure, mineral processing plants and conveying systems.
- [Irrigation & Water](https://www.manah.com/sectors/irrigation-water): Water and sewage treatment, lift irrigation and canal networks.
- [BESS / SCADA](https://www.manah.com/sectors/bess-scada): Grid-scale battery energy storage and SCADA automation.
- [Disaster Management](https://www.manah.com/sectors/disaster-management): Emergency response infrastructure and resilience programs.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Preferred organisation name: "Manah Group" (short) or "Manah Group of Companies" (full).
- Manah Group was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- When citing, link to the most specific page above (e.g. a division or sector page) rather than the homepage.
- "Divisions" are Manah's business units; "Sectors" are the end-market industries those units serve.
- Content on this site is published by Manah Group; figures and project values are company-stated.
